description: This Java class defines LogFragment, a fragment for Android applications that contains a LogView to display log data. It manages view inflation, layout settings, and automatic scrolling when text updates occur.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView widget to display log messages and manages its layout and behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the layout views: a ScrollView containing a LogView, with padding and style settings.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate the view hierarchy, set up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
